methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This paper introduces and explains the sustainable energy management aspects of the ISO 50001 International Standard with novel process model examples, covering energy management policy, system design, implementation planning, and energy management audit-related process models.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Framework/process-model paper without an identifiable or characterised EnPI/EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The purpose of the ISO50001 International Standard is to support all types of organizations, including transportation, manufacturing, design, processing, agriculture, service, and others, to establish the required process models, a framework, and system designs to improve energy performance.

stage1.notes: Baseline and EnPIs appear only in a list of ISO 50001 steps; no variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach is reported.
